name: 490-probe-copy-corrupted-command-not-run
note: #490: built from the issue text, not from a raw capture (the canary typed value is not in the issue). The session-root probe command is now a short script run by path (a b64 under 200 characters); the probe agent still typed a corrupted copy (here: the command followed by stray quotes), probe-run.cjs refused it against --expect-cmd (exit -1, empty-output digest, cmd= the digest of refused:<typed text>, stderr expect-cmd-mismatch). The run ends provision-failed with probeReason command-not-run and the result now carries probeStderr expect-cmd-mismatch. The engine retries a read probe once with a fresh agent (#486): the second answer repeats the recorded failure (no raw capture of a retry exists; the next canary run replaces it).

args.brief: a corrupted probe copy must end as command-not-run with the refusal cause in the result
